name: British citizenship by naturalisation

requirements.blocker_text: This requires holding Indefinite Leave to Remain (or settled status) for at least 12 months before applying.
This requires 5 years of lawful residence in the UK.
This requires meeting the good character requirement.
This requires English at CEFR B1, unless aged 65+ or medically exempt.
requirements.fix_path: Take an approved Secure English Language Test at B1.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires passing the Life in the UK Test, unless aged 65+ or medically exempt.
requirements.fix_path: Book and pass the Life in the UK Test.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires no more than 450 days outside the UK in the qualifying 5 years, and no more than 90 days in the final 12 months.

requirement_groups.name: Married to (or civil partner of) a British citizen (section 6(2))

requirements.blocker_text: This requires holding Indefinite Leave to Remain (or settled status) — no 12-month wait is required on this route, unlike the general route.
This requires 3 years of lawful residence in the UK.
This requires being married to, or the civil partner of, a British citizen.
This requires meeting the good character requirement.
This requires English at CEFR B1, unless aged 65+ or medically exempt.
requirements.fix_path: Take an approved Secure English Language Test at B1.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires passing the Life in the UK Test, unless aged 65+ or medically exempt.
requirements.fix_path: Book and pass the Life in the UK Test.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires no more than 270 days outside the UK across the qualifying 3 years, and no more than 90 days in the final 12 months.

evidence_required.document: Life in the UK Test pass certificate (unless exempt)
Approved English test at B1, unless exempt
5 (or 3) years of continuous residence evidence, including full absence history

notes: This is the final link in the core Student → Graduate → Skilled Worker → ILR → Citizenship Journey. Fee is £1,839 total (£1,709 application + £130 ceremony), confirmed via gov.uk citizenship fees, updated 8 April 2026 — several secondary sources still show £1,344/£1,605/£1,735, another counterfeit-figure case. No IHS (citizenship is not a visa). Dual citizenship permitted by the UK regardless of route. MAJOR LIVE POLICY RISK, same class as uk_ilr: the November 2025 'Earned Settlement' consultation (closed 12 Feb 2026) could push the underlying ILR qualifying period from 5 to 10 years, which flows directly into this route's prerequisites; the May 2025 White Paper also signalled a possible longer residence requirement for naturalisation itself. Re-verify monthly alongside uk_ilr until this resolves. English requirement is B1 currently; watch for alignment with the ILR B1→B2 change from March 2027. Known schema gap: 'via_ancestry' is not a separate group here because UK Ancestry visa holders naturalise via the standard ILR route, not a distinct citizenship pathway — confirmed via direct research, not assumed.
